ledger.note: 12 February 1992: the Mongolian People's Republic becomes the State of Mongolia. 'Current constitution: 12 February 1992'; 'A new constitution was introduced in 1992, and the term "People's Republic" was dropped from the name.' The Mongolian People's Republic page: 'Communist state abolished: 12 February 1992', 'officially known as the State of Mongolia'.

certainty.note: Judgement: a settled international frontier with Russia to the north and China to the south ('bordered by Russia to the north and China to the south'); neither page opened dates a treaty or survey, and neither records a frontier change after 1992.

notes: Two pages opened (the budget). Mongolia is one outline for its whole life; the only event is the 1992 re-founding, with the Mongolian People's Republic (14 Cliopatria shapes, 1926-1991, written by an earlier ia-03 part) as predecessor. Start 12 February 1992 (the constitution in force); the 1990 democratic revolution (March 1990 resignation of the MPRP leadership, first multi-party elections 29 June 1990) and the Soviet troop withdrawal of 1987-1992 belong to the predecessor and to the Soviet Union's dossier. The Mongolia page does not name its presidents (only Khurelsukh, elected June 2021, appears), so no rulers list is given. The page gives 1949 (not 1946) for China's recognition, 1911 and 1921 for independence and 27 October 1961 for the UN; none moved a border after 1992. Frontier surveys are not on either page: a gap-filler may open the Mongolia-China and Mongolia-Russia border pages if sharp edges need sourcing.
